meta.title: Netcap behavioral baseline: learning does not grant trust

cards.title: Only three runtime modes
items: The diagram shows the actual learning, monitoring and paused modes (internal/behavior/engine.go:93,350,362).
Defaults require 7 days of capture-time coverage and 100 observations. Sleeping after a short replay adds no coverage (engine.go:41-45,343; docs/behavioral-monitoring.md:10).
Initial approval requires observed facts, enough samples/time and no fact or window overflow (engine.go:342-357).

cards.title: Review actions that remain in Monitoring
items: acknowledge records a review and changes no approved fact. approve-changes adds selected observed facts and creates a new baseline version (engine.go:392-422).
suppress records an exception reason; unsuppress removes it. Neither action approves the fact (engine.go:409-412).
Unapproved and unsuppressed deviations can emit alerts while the approved baseline stays frozen (engine.go:206-234).

cards.title: Scope and persistence
items: On the Paused-to-Learning arrow, maintenance means explicit relearn or reset, regardless of the prior mode. Both clear observations; reset also clears approved facts and models. The Monitoring-to-Learning arrow has the same maintenance semantics (engine.go:368-391).
Observations are scoped by sensor, interface and VLAN; approval cannot be learned automatically (docs/behavioral-monitoring.md:3,71-82).
Changes require a reason and, through ChangeAtVersion, the expected baseline version. State is copied, validated and persisted before becoming live (engine.go:309-340,418-428).
A baseline has a single-writer lock. Paused mode returns before observing new facts (engine.go:68-74,139-141).
